title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #14

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which surah says "Say: He is Allah, the One"? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Kafirun
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. An-Naas
   D. Al-Masad

2. Which surah tells us not to worship what the disbelievers worship? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Ikhlas
   B. An-Nasr
   C. Al-Kafirun
   D. Al-Fatiha

3. Which surah contains the words "You have your religion and I have mine"? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Ikhlas
   B. Al-Masad
   C. Al-Kafirun
   D. An-Nasr

4. What did the Prophet (S.A.W.) do to solve the dispute about placing the Black Stone? (1 mark)
   A. Asked one tribe alone to place it
   B. Placed it on a cloak and let leaders lift it together
   C. Kept it for himself
   D. Threw it away

5. What does "akhlaq" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Direction of prayer
   C. Prayer times
   D. Character and manners

6. "Ya Sami', hear my dua." Which name is used? (1 mark)
   A. As-Sami'
   B. Al-Basir
   C. Ar-Rahim
   D. Al-Malik

7. What is the correct way to mention an angel's name? (1 mark)
   A. Say nothing
   B. Say "alayhis-salam"
   C. Insult
   D. Say "S.A.W."

8. What is a mukhaffafah najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A light najasa
   B. A heavy najasa
   C. A medium najasa
   D. A pure thing

9. What does the Prophet say about wudhu on the Day of Judgement? (1 mark)
   A. Wudhu will be forgotten
   B. Believers will have shining marks from wudhu
   C. Nothing
   D. Only rich people will shine

10. Which verse commands wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 5:6
   B. Qur'an 110:3
   C. Qur'an 1:2
   D. Qur'an 112:1

11. Which prayer has two rak'ahs? (1 mark)
   A. Asr
   B. Maghrib
   C. Dhuhr
   D. Fajr

12. What is tayammum? (1 mark)
   A. A type of prayer
   B. Using clean earth when water cannot be used
   C. A dua
   D. Washing with soap

13. Which subject helps you find directions with a compass? (1 mark)
   A. Music
   B. Art
   C. Social Studies
   D. Cookery only

14. How many sujud are in each rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Three
   C. One
   D. Four

15. What is tartib? (1 mark)
   A. Making dua
   B. Praying without wudhu
   C. Praying fast
   D. Doing the pillars in order

16. What should you do before putting a load on a donkey? (1 mark)
   A. Make sure it is not too heavy
   B. Hit it
   C. Add extra sacks
   D. Ignore its health

17. Which is a safe practice around stray dogs? (1 mark)
   A. Do not go near them and tell an adult
   B. Feed them by hand
   C. Tease them
   D. Chase them

18. What is a buibui? (1 mark)
   A. A cap
   B. A prayer
   C. A drink
   D. A black cover worn by women along the coast

19. What is a kofia? (1 mark)
   A. A cap
   B. A coat
   C. A shoe
   D. A belt

20. Which of these is honest work? (1 mark)
   A. Gambling
   B. Stealing
   C. Farming
   D. Cheating

21. What do we say at the end of a dua? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Bismillah
   C. Nothing
   D. Goodbye

22. What is an obligation? (1 mark)
   A. A punishment
   B. A gift
   C. A game
   D. A duty that must be done

23. What is muamalat? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A journey
   C. A fast
   D. The way people deal with each other

24. What can a child do if parents are poor and cannot buy everything? (1 mark)
   A. Be patient and make dua for them
   B. Refuse to speak
   C. Steal
   D. Complain loudly

25. What is one reward of being good to parents? (1 mark)
   A. Trouble
   B. Nothing
   C. Blessing and Allah's pleasure
   D. Loss

26. Who is a "bibi"? (1 mark)
   A. Cousin
   B. Grandfather
   C. Uncle
   D. Grandmother

27. Which is a bad habit toward relatives? (1 mark)
   A. Helping them
   B. Greeting them
   C. Visiting them
   D. Gossiping about them

28. What did Abu Bakr do with his wealth? (1 mark)
   A. Freed believers and supported Islam
   B. Refused to give
   C. Wasted it
   D. Hid it

29. Which virtue is shown by refusing revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Envy
   C. Mercy
   D. Anger

30. To which town did the Prophet go to invite people to Islam about ten years after the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. Taif
   B. Cairo
   C. Madinah
   D. Habasha

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. List the steps of brushing teeth correctly. (3 marks)

32. Give three positive uses of media. (3 marks)

33. Describe how to clean a place licked by a dog. (3 marks)

34. Suggest three honest ways of earning a living. (3 marks)

35. State three ways Khadija (R.A.) helped the Prophet (S.A.W.). (3 marks)

36. Explain, using one of the angels, how angels' duties help us in our lives. (5 marks)

37. Explain the meaning of the hadith "I have been sent for the purpose of perfecting good morals". (3 marks)

38. Write the meaning of the dua for leaving the house. (3 marks)

39. How should a Muslim treat dogs even though their saliva is heavy najasa? (3 marks)

40. List the steps of wudhu in order from the hands to the feet. (3 marks)

41. Explain what the Prophet taught about cutting and selling firewood. (3 marks)

42. Why is it wrong to pray on time but shout at your family? (3 marks)

43. Define wudhu and state its intention. (2 marks)

44. Explain tuma'ninah and give the story that shows its importance. (3 marks)

45. Explain the meaning of "The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, while there is good in both." (3 marks)

46. Narrate briefly what happened to the Prophet in Taif. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Al-Ikhlas
   These are the first words of Al-Ikhlas.

2. C — Al-Kafirun
   Al-Kafirun states this firmly and ends "For you your religion, for me mine".

3. C — Al-Kafirun
   This is the last verse of Al-Kafirun.

4. B — Placed it on a cloak and let leaders lift it together
   The cloak let every tribe share in the honour.

5. D — Character and manners
   Akhlaq means moral character.

6. A — As-Sami'
   Sami' means All-Hearing.

7. B — Say "alayhis-salam"
   We say peace be upon him.

8. A — A light najasa
   Mukhaffafah means light.

9. B — Believers will have shining marks from wudhu
   Recorded by Muslim.

10. A — Qur'an 5:6
   Surah Al-Ma'idah 5:6.

11. D — Fajr
   Fajr has two.

12. B — Using clean earth when water cannot be used
   It is a substitute in some cases.

13. C — Social Studies
   Social Studies teaches direction finding.

14. A — Two
   Each rak'ah has two sujud.

15. D — Doing the pillars in order
   It means order.

16. A — Make sure it is not too heavy
   Do not overload an animal.

17. A — Do not go near them and tell an adult
   Some animals may bite.

18. D — A black cover worn by women along the coast
   A buibui is a cover.

19. A — A cap
   A kofia is a cap.

20. C — Farming
   Honest work is farming.

21. A — Amin
   Amin means "O Allah, accept".

22. D — A duty that must be done
   Obligation means duty.

23. D — The way people deal with each other
   Muamalat covers social relations.

24. A — Be patient and make dua for them
   Understand their situation.

25. C — Blessing and Allah's pleasure
   It is among the best deeds.

26. D — Grandmother
   Bibi means grandmother.

27. D — Gossiping about them
   Gossip breaks ties.

28. A — Freed believers and supported Islam
   He bought and freed people.

29. C — Mercy
   Mercy is being kind to those who hurt us.

30. A — Taif
   He went to Taif.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say Bismillah, use a pea-sized amount of paste, brush outer, inner and chewing surfaces, brush the tongue, rinse and store the brush.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct group of steps up to 3.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Learning, listening to Qur'an and lessons, keeping in touch with family, news, safe skills.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash seven times with water, one washing being mixed with clean soil, then rinse and dry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for seven washings, 1 mark for soil once, 1 mark for rinsing.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Farming, trading in a kiosk, tailoring, carpentry, teaching.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: She was first to believe, comforted him, supported him with wealth, stayed with him in hardship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: Jibril brought the Qur'an that guides us; Mikail's duty of rain helps crops; Raqib and Atid keep record so we can be rewarded; Malakul Maut reminds us to prepare; Israfil reminds us of the Day of Judgement.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the name, 1 mark for the duty, 1 mark for the benefit, 2 marks for a clear explanation.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Prophet's mission included completing and perfecting good character. Good manners are part of the faith and must be practised every day.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for perfecting good morals, 1 mark for part of faith, 1 mark for daily practice.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might and no power except with Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kindly, without cruelty, giving them food and water, and only being careful to avoid their saliva.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness, 1 mark for not cruel, 1 mark for careful with saliva.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hands, mouth, nose, face, arms to elbows, wipe head and ears, feet to ankles.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each three steps in the right order.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Honest work, even hard work like cutting and selling firewood, is better than asking people who may give or refuse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for honest work, 1 mark for firewood, 1 mark for better than begging.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Islam teaches that faith includes good manners. The Prophet was sent to perfect good morals, so prayer and character go together.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for faith including manners, 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the conclusion.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wudhu is washing certain parts of the body with water to prepare for prayer. The intention is made in the heart.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for definition and 1 mark for intention.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tuma'ninah is staying still and calm in each position. The Prophet told a man who prayed hurriedly to go back and pray again.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for the story, 1 mark for the lesson.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Both types have good because of faith. But a strong believer can do more good, so a Muslim should try to be strong in body and faith.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for good in both, 1 mark for strong can do more good, 1 mark for the lesson.

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: He invited the leaders and they rejected him rudely, some people threw stones at him and Zayd, his feet bled, and he took shelter in a garden and made dua.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four points.
